settings.content:
A mom with a passion for empowering other moms to make magical moments and cute creations.

My mission is to inspire, uplift, encourage, and enable moms to easily and confidently turn the simple into the spectacular.

settings.heading: It started with wanting to make the moment feel special.
settings.subtext: Not a perfect Pinterest moment. A real one. A fun party, a cute cake, and that feeling when your kid’s face lights up.
settings.text_top:
When I was a young mom, I loved throwing fun parties for my kids and making every memory count. There was nothing better than seeing their excitement when I nailed the theme and made something that felt special.

But I struggled with it. I wanted to be the mom who could whip up something delicious, beautiful, and homemade, but doing that on a budget was hard. I’d often have to buy ten different things to make one thing, and almost always ended up with more than I needed.
settings.quote: “I wanted to help other regular moms making something special while doing twenty other things at once.”
settings.text_bottom:
I saw so many moms feeling like they couldn't make something special. They needed to know they were more than capable of making something that wowed their kids and friends and made them feel like a super mom.

That's when I began creating one-of-a-kind sprinkle mixes, so anyone could transform a simple dessert in mere minutes and only buy what they actually needed.

In 2011, I opened an Etsy shop selling sprinkles and custom birthday decorations so I could help people create fearlessly, make memories, and feel good about themselves.

Then in 2019, Cool Mom Sprinkles officially began. Today, the mission is still simple: fight against overpriced sprinkles and a lack of confidence in the kitchen.

I'm honored to help you sprinkle magic and pizzazz into everyday life, make events memorable, and celebrate with confidence.

settings.title: Integrity
settings.text: We never want you to spend more than you need to. We'll let you know exactly how many sprinkles you need for a specific dessert.

settings.title: Confidence
settings.text: We confidently believe in your ability to make magical things and make it our goal to uplift, encourage, and educate you to do so.

settings.title: Quality
settings.text: We hand mix every small batch ensuring every mix has the same amount of specialty sprinkles as the last.

settings.title: Care
settings.text: We're a small team, and we interact directly with every customer. Connect with us for sprinkle questions, baking tips, and custom mixes for your next event!

settings.heading:

Real Happiness.
